```{r}
# Part Two Question 1
library(tidyverse) # loads packages
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
communityareas<-read_html("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Community_areas_of_Chicago") # loads the html file


#EXTRACT TABLE AS DATAFRAME
CAtable <- communityareas %>%
  html_element("table") %>%
  html_table()

head(CAtable)

FinalCAtable<- CAtable[-c(1,79),] %>% # removes rows 1 & 79 from original
  select(No.,Name,Population) %>% # only keeps the number name and population
  mutate(
    Population = str_remove_all(Population,","),
    Population = as.numeric(Population) # removes comma and makes population numeric
)

FinalCAtable %>% slice(24) # West Town

FinalCAtable %>%  # Arranges population high to low then gets top 5
  arrange(desc(Population)) %>%
  head(5)

```
```{r, part 1 question2}
library(readr)
bookhtml <- read_html("https://books.toscrape.com/")


eachbook <- bookhtml |> # each book section
  html_elements("article.product_pod")
eachbook

title = eachbook |> #title of each book
  html_element("h3") |> 
  html_text2()
title


price = eachbook |> #price of each book
  html_element("p.price_color") |> 
  html_text2()
price


availability = eachbook |>  #availility of each book
  html_element("p.instock.availability") |> 
  html_text2()
availability

bookstoscrape <- tibble( # creates table
  title, 
  price,
  availability
)



cleanbookstoscrape <-bookstoscrape %>% # cleans table and makes price numeric
   mutate(
    price = str_remove_all(price,"£"),
    price = as.numeric(price)
)

write_csv(cleanbookstoscrape, "books.csv") # saves table as csv and in repo

```

```{r part 3}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# answer to part 3 question 1
url <- "https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/v6vf-nfxy.json"

params <- list( #creates a filter that will go through API
  community_area = "24",
   `$where` = "created_date >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00'",
  `$order` = "created_date DESC",
  `$limit` = 1000
)
res <- GET(url, query = params)

#question 2
dat <- fromJSON(content(res, "text")) # dataframe created fromJSON 
head(dat)

nrow(dat)

colnames(dat)
```
